body:
On the release 100-project / 10k-card / 50k-report fixture, earlier receipt filtering and selection of existing review/decision partial indexes reduce all-read 50k-receipt Focus Attention median from 85.5 to 52.7 ms and p95 from 91.9 to 59.5 ms. Without receipts the median improves from 22.5 to 15.2 ms. Each compared profile has 200 measurements after 20 warm calls. Ordering, scopes, decisions, receipt identity, source authority and durable writes are preserved; no new index or cache is added.

The full gate passes 260 Rust, 139 JavaScript and 12 Python tests. Focus, events and protocol pass in Chromium and WebKit against real release daemons. The rebuilt/restarted manual app preserves 52 prior source versions, two pins, preferences and certificate; trusted HTTPS and all 33 assets are verified. Evidence: progress/2026-09-30-focus-eligibility-indexes.md. Other history distributions, dense Calendar, source-current tag scans, write outliers and physical/end-to-end acceptance remain open.

metadata.summary: Verified earlier receipt filtering and existing partial indexes accelerate Focus Attention.
